new_result.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate cap-one product banks X,Y and another independent original coordinate W, M!=0 with sigma=||M||op, arbitrary alpha,G(Y), a!=0,d,c, T=X^T M Y+alpha^T X+G(Y)+aW^2+dW+c has a continuous C0 density with ||p_T||inf<=16/sqrt(|a| sigma).
proof_currency: Rudelson--Vershynin Theorem 1.2 gives conditional scalar density cap sqrt(2)/||My+alpha|| and top-singular projection cap sqrt(2)/sigma
the random conditional cap has tail P(K>s)<=4/(sigma s)
layer cake gives p_R^*(t)<=C(1+log(1/(Ct))) for t<=1/C and <=1/t afterwards, C=4/sigma
the translated square density satisfies g^*(t)<=1/sqrt(|a|t)
Hardy--Littlewood/O'Neil endpoint convolution gives the L-infinity bound; L21 compact approximation gives C0 continuity

primary_sources: Rudelson--Vershynin, Small ball probabilities for linear images of high dimensional distributions, arXiv:1402.4492, Theorem 1.2
Richard O'Neil, Convolution operators and L(p,q) spaces, Duke Math. J. 30 (1963), 129--142, DOI 10.1215/S0012-7094-63-03015-1
unresolved_implication: Bare s_3(A)>=1 does not force a target-scale product-preserving cross-plus-private-square decomposition. The global compiler must extract this geometry or route its failure into paid E3/ridge/grouped-hub/pair-log mechanisms with arbitrary extra spectrum retained.
